topic: block headings must be derived from the range, not the block key
lesson: BLOCKING (contract verdict t-sv-c3). formatBlockHeading in statement-view.tsx:161 branches on the block KEY - treating anything keyed 'selected' as a single month and formatting only its 'to'. That breaks the exact degenerate case the human ruled on: when the selected period IS the FY-YTD, the route returns ONE block keyed 'selected' whose from/to span April to July, and the view heads four months as 'July 2026'. Derive the heading from the RANGE, as the criterion says: when from and to fall in the same month, 'July 2026'; when they span months, 'FY 26-27 (YTD to <last month>)'. The block key says which slot it is, not what period it covers. Extend the single-block required leaf to assert the heading of that deduped block, not just that one block renders - the existing leaf passed while the heading was wrong, which is why this reached review.
